sections.heading: 1. Eligibility Requirements
heading_path: 1. Eligibility Requirements
content:
You are a transit or transfer passenger at Changi Airport. Please note that you can only enter and exit Singapore once during your layover, in compliance with the regulations set by the [Immigration and Checkpoints Authority of Singapore](https://apc01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ica.gov.sg%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cwong.hiutung%40changiairport.com%7C71e87bb75106446df29908ddf9bb39f5%7C258c993422fa404884c8c52b473187ce%7C0%7C0%7C638941304908054406%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=k9XlCyfjx6LrMhntEMcsdLEgzWbAE%2Bd5QEDDi%2BkMfsM%3D&reserved=0). Passengers holding passports from certain countries (including India and Pakistan) will require a valid Singapore entry visa to travel to and seek entry into Singapore. You can find more information about entry visa requirements [here](https://www.ica.gov.sg/enter-transit-depart/entering-singapore/visa_requirements).

Your checked-in baggage should be through checked to your end destination.

Your layover duration should be between 5.5 to 24 hours. Your flight schedule should meet the requirements of the tour timings (refer to Tour Schedules and Itineraries below).

Please take note of the reporting time (refer to Tour Schedules and Itineraries below), and ensure there is sufficient time upon plane disembarkation to reach the registration counter.

sections.heading: 2. How do I register?
heading_path: 2. How do I register?
content:
You can pre-book one (1) tour itinerary up to fifty (50) days prior to your intended tour date.

Alternatively, you can visit our tour booth(s) in the transit area upon arrival for assistance. Please note that seats are subject to availability, and there may be a balance of seats for walk-in passengers.

Upon arrival at Changi Airport, please remain in the transit area and refrain from clearing Arrival immigration as the Free Singapore Tour booths are located within the transit area.

The Free Singapore Tour booths are located at:

T2

TRANSIT

Level2, Departure Transit Hall

(Near Gate F50)

Opening hours:

8:00AM-7:00PM

T3

TRANSIT

Level2, Departure Transit Hall

(Near Gate A1-A8)

Opening hours:

8:00AM-7:00PM

sections.heading: 3. What do I need to join the tour?
heading_path: 3. What do I need to join the tour?
content:
Passport, boarding passes, valid [entry visa](https://www.ica.gov.sg/enter-transit-depart/entering-singapore/visa_requirements) (if required) and tour booking confirmation are required for registration. Eligibility to participate in the tour is subject to entry requirements stipulated by the [Immigration and Checkpoints Authority of Singapore](https://www.ica.gov.sg/).

If you have bulky or wheeled cabin baggage, alcohol, or duty-free items, you must deposit them at a [Baggage Storage counter](https://www.changiairport.com/en/at-changi/facilities-and-services-directory/baggage-storage.html) in the transit area before checking in for the tour. Please note that fees apply for this service.

Electronic devices are not permitted to be stored. They must be hand-carried during the tour.

sections.heading: 4. Important Notes
heading_path: 4. Important Notes
content:
Seats are allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.

Each transit passenger is permitted to reserve only one tour during their layover.

Tour itineraries are subject to change, depending on weather and traffic conditions.

Items such as Tobacco, cigarettes, vaporizers and e-cigarettes are not permitted on all tours, as the listed items are either banned or taxable upon entry into the Republic of Singapore.

sections.heading: 1. Are the tours available every day?
heading_path: 1. Are the tours available every day?
content: The tours are available daily, including weekends and public holidays.

sections.heading: 2. When are the Free Singapore Tour booths open?
heading_path: 2. When are the Free Singapore Tour booths open?
content: The Free Singapore Tour booths are open daily. The operating hours are T2 Transit Level2, Departure Transit Hall (Near Gate F50) Opening hours: 8:00AM-7:00PM T3 TRANSIT Level2, Departure Transit Hall (Near Gate A1-A8) Opening hours: 8:00AM-7:00PM

sections.heading: 3. What language is the Free Singapore Tour conducted in?
heading_path: 3. What language is the Free Singapore Tour conducted in?
content: All tours are conducted in English. Chinese audio devices are available upon request at the registration booth

sections.heading: 4. I want to join the Free Singapore Tour but I do not have an entry visa into Singapore. Can I still join the Free Singapore Tour?
heading_path: 4. I want to join the Free Singapore Tour but I do not have an entry visa into Singapore. Can I still join the Free Singapore Tour?
content:
Depending on the issuing country of the passport you are holding, passengers of eligible nationalities enjoy visa-free entry into Singapore. Please click [here](https://www.ica.gov.sg/enteranddeparting/before/entryvisa) to find out if you require a visa to enter Singapore. Possession of a valid visa does not guarantee entry into Singapore. Please refer to the [entry requirements](https://www.ica.gov.sg/enter-transit-depart/entering-singapore) for more information.

Visa Free Transit Facility (VFTF)

Passengers of eligible nationalities may also qualify for VFTF if prevailing entry requirements are met. Assessment for entry is determined by the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) officers at the point of entry. For more information, please click [here](https://www.ica.gov.sg/enter-transit-depart/entering-singapore/visa-free-transit-facility).

Please note that extension of stay is strictly prohibited for transit travellers under the VFTF.

sections.heading: 5. Do I need to fill in the Singapore Arrival Card?
heading_path: 5. Do I need to fill in the Singapore Arrival Card?
content:
Yes, it is a requirement for clearing Arrival Immigration. For a seamless experience, you are strongly encouraged to complete the online [Singapore Arrival Card](https://www.ica.gov.sg/enter-transit-depart/entering-singapore/sg-arrival-card) within three (3) days prior to the date of arrival in Singapore.

For more information, please visit: [https://www.ica.gov.sg/enter-transit-depart/entering-singapore/sg-arrival-card](https://www.ica.gov.sg/enter-transit-depart/entering-singapore/sg-arrival-card)

sections.heading: 6. Can I pre-book the Free Singapore Tour?
heading_path: 6. Can I pre-book the Free Singapore Tour?
content:
Yes, you can pre-book only one (1) tour itinerary up to fifty (50) days before your intended tour date. Before booking, please ensure that your layover coincides with the tour schedules. Once you're ready, select your preferred tour, date, and time, and follow the booking process.

Upon arrival at Changi Airport, please make your way to the nearest Free Singapore Tour booth in the Transit Area at least 90 minutes before your scheduled tour timing.

sections.heading: 7. What are the terms and conditions of joining the Free Singapore Tour?
heading_path: 7. What are the terms and conditions of joining the Free Singapore Tour?
content:
Please refer to the [Terms and Conditions](https://fst.changiairport.com/terms-and-conditions) of the Free Singapore Tour.

All Free Singapore Tour participants are required to sign an Indemnity Form when reporting at the Free Singapore Tour service counter before commencement of tour.

sections.heading: 8. I am only arriving after the Reporting Time. Can I still join the Free Singapore Tour?
heading_path: 8. I am only arriving after the Reporting Time. Can I still join the Free Singapore Tour?
content: To ensure a smooth experience for all tour participants, it is essential for transit passengers to arrive at the Free Singapore Tour booth at least 90 minutes prior to the scheduled tour start time for the check-in process and attendance confirmation.

sections.heading: 9. I am arriving in Singapore but not transiting. Can I join the Free Singapore Tour?
heading_path: 9. I am arriving in Singapore but not transiting. Can I join the Free Singapore Tour?
content: The Free Singapore Tour is exclusively available for transit and transfer passengers of Changi Airport only. If you are visiting Singapore, you are not eligible to participate in the tour.

sections.heading: 10. Can I join the Free Singapore Tour and remain in the city to explore on my own before returning to the airport for my connecting flight?
heading_path: 10. Can I join the Free Singapore Tour and remain in the city to explore on my own before returning to the airport for my connecting flight?
content:
You are encouraged to complete the entire tour. If you decide to leave mid-way, you will need to arrange your own transport back to the airport at your own expense. Changi Airport is not responsible for any missed connecting flights.

At the end of the tour, you will be dropped off at Jewel Changi Airport/Terminal 1, Terminal 2 or Terminal 3.

You are responsible for your flight check-in and security procedures at the respective terminals.

sections.heading: 11. I require a wheelchair to get around. Can I join the Free Singapore Tour?
heading_path: 11. I require a wheelchair to get around. Can I join the Free Singapore Tour?
content: Unfortunately, the tours are not suitable for wheelchair and stroller users due to the tour route.

sections.heading: 12. Can I join more than one of the Free Singapore Tour itineraries?
heading_path: 12. Can I join more than one of the Free Singapore Tour itineraries?
content: You can only participate in one tour as transit passengers can only enter and exit Singapore once, in accordance with the guidelines provided by the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority of Singapore (ICA). More information on each of the tour itineraries are available on the Free Singapore Tour website.

sections.heading: 13. I am below 18 years old and travelling by myself. Can I join the Free Singapore Tour?
heading_path: 13. I am below 18 years old and travelling by myself. Can I join the Free Singapore Tour?
content: Passengers below 18 years old are unable to participate in the tour alone unless accompanied by an adult. All passengers have to sign an indemnity form prior to the tour, and signatories must be 18 years old and above.

sections.heading: 14. I am late in returning to the tour bus and missed the tour bus transport back to the airport, what do I do?
heading_path: 14. I am late in returning to the tour bus and missed the tour bus transport back to the airport, what do I do?
content: In the unlikely event that participants are separated from the tour group, they must arrange their own transportation to the airport at their own expense.

sections.heading: 15. I am unable to attend the tour. How do I cancel my booking?
heading_path: 15. I am unable to attend the tour. How do I cancel my booking?
content:
You will receive a confirmation email once your tour is confirmed. The email includes a cancellation link under the “Cancellation Policy” section. Simply click the link and enter your unique PIN to cancel your booking.

Please note that if you do not cancel your booking and do not show up for the tour, this may impact your eligibility for future bookings.
